submission.natural_language_explanation: This pole is a retrospective detector that fires on the token ' of' (with activation often persisting onto the immediately following token, sometimes larger there) when that 'of' introduces the complement of a preceding head noun drawn from a restricted subset (measured firing: powerhouse, capital, city, cups, King, Choir, dog, book; measured silent: manager, president, color, end, smell, power, Bank, University) regardless of determiner, sentence position, or complement; it stays at baseline for other prepositions in the same frames and for 'of' after non-member nouns. The exact boundary of the head-noun subset is uncharacterized (acknowledged leftover), and the uniform ~0.12 position-0 activation is a nonspecific baseline, not signal. Not lookahead: the Jacobian lens is flat (kurtosis ~3.1, incoherent promoted fragments) and the post-peak token varies freely.
